name: THE ABYSS
tagline: Seven trials at the edge of the hunter’s certainty.
introText: THE ABYSS strips away trail and record. What remains is the trial in front of the hunter, and the self that answers it.
completionText: The Rite, the Risen, the Crooked, the Breaking, the Wraith, the Descent, and the Ravager have each been faced. The last mark ends. What it marks remains unknown.

territoryLore.theTerritory: THE ABYSS takes away the trail and the walls. Distance has no clear measure here.
territoryLore.whatDwellsHere: Ritual, return, imbalance, fracture, absence, and descent take forms that resist easy explanation.
territoryLore.huntersPurpose: There is no record of what waits below. Only the test before you, and what it asks you to spend.
territoryLore.transition: The final mark ends. What it marks does not.
